title: Server crashes when POST /notes body is not valid JSON
body: Sending `curl -X POST localhost:8080/notes -d 'not json'` kills the whole process with `SyntaxError: Unexpected token`. Expected a 400 response instead of a crash.

title: README says `npm run serve` but that script does not exist
body: Following the Getting started section fails: `npm ERR! Missing script: "serve"`. Also the server did not start on port 3000 for me.

title: Add pagination to GET /notes
body: With a few thousand notes the list endpoint returns everything at once. It would be nice to support `?limit=` and `?offset=`.

title: Notes with a whitespace-only title are accepted
body: `{"title": "   "}` is accepted and creates a note with a blank title. Titles should be trimmed before validation.

title: How do I change where notes are stored?
body: I set NOTES_FILE=/data/notes.json as the README says but notes still end up in ./notes.json. Am I doing something wrong?
